verdict.rationale: Ramp's evidence describes payment rails, such as same-day ACH, international wires, RTP instant payments and 1–2 business day reimbursements. Nothing documents an exact delivery estimate shown to the user before they confirm an ACH or wire transfer. General rail-speed marketing is adjacent at best and does not meet this pre-confirmation estimate story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can see the exact delivery estimate for an ACH or wire transfer before confirming it
